title: Huesca 1488 original-book follow-up: qualified reissued-sheet evidence and unresolved original access

accepted_metadata_corrections: Annual volume composition date changed to unknown; only its original 1910 publication is established.
GW catalogue edition language corrected from fr to de.
Additional deferrals explicitly enumerate the full mixed-volume text extraction and all 26 reproducible review rasters.

uses.disposition: Original 1488 service book not acquired in this bounded public pass; exact historical scholarly article and catalogue facts retained. No new stage, recension, native text or Git parent asserted.

searches.repository: Public web search, institutional/librarian bibliographic routes and holding-library public entry pages
searches.result: GW M24589 identifies two public copies/fragments: New York Hispanic Society and Zaragoza Cathedral (defective). Its four image links are catalogue cards, not original-book pages. No authenticated full original Huesca 1488 digital book was acquired. This is not an exhaustive holding-library or internet absence result.

searches.repository: GW M24589 and CERL ISTC direct routes
searches.result: Complete GW response and all four card-image deliveries acquired; bounded factual metadata retained. The exact ISTC response was a bot interstitial, not a catalogue record. No challenge/session metadata enters canonical or public records.

searches.repository: Hispanic Society public library and Digital Collections landing pages
searches.result: Library page expressly limits online-catalogue coverage and points to a full onsite catalogue. Its linked public search requires a JavaScript/session-bearing route; no completed original-book catalogue search is claimed. Public Digital Collections landing page supplied no Huesca item link in the inspected response. No institution contacted or appointment requested.

searches.repository: Persée and Internet Archive public periodical routes
searches.result: Persée offered whole-article PDF returned HTTP403. Guessed old IA alias returned empty JSON; advanced search identified bulletin-hispanique_1910_12. Complete 476-page PDF and raw OCR were acquired. PDF1 identifies a 1970 Swets reprint, not an original 1910 delivery; the 26 complete historical article pages29-54 were extracted and retained. No retrieval route through model-generated text.

versions.reported_exact_imprint: 1 June 1488, Hans Hurus, Zaragoza, as GW and Lambert report
source_loci: Lambert, sectionVII, printed42-44; retained article PDF20-22

claims.claim: Lambert describes adapting 1485 Zaragoza sheets: replaced Huesca calendar (eleven preliminary leaves, or at least the first gathering of eight), temporal leaf1 with the bishop letter, Sanctoral leaf119 with the colophon, and a pasted local title.
The archbishop supplication remained in the Holy Saturday litany, specifically temporal folio110r,column2,line3 as the article reports.

Lambert reports his copy stops at Sanctoral folio135. Its missing tail prevents deciding whether a Huesca/Jaca/Barbastro saints supplement followed. His separate view that a supplement is unlikely does not establish absence.

limits: Specific original book pages, the alleged reused sheets and the missing-tail question remain unverified by this project against the 1488 physical book or its facsimile.
A bibliographic reissue with a changed calendar is not automatically a separate whole liturgical recension; no complete textual-state bridge or native Git parent is established.
The 1910 article, consulted in a 1970 photographic reprint, is a separate source object from the historical 1488 service book.

limitations: Original Huesca 1488 book not acquired; no exhaustive holding-library or internet absence claim.
Lambert 1910 copy is defective at tail; possible local saints supplement remains uncheckable.
Calendar/letter/colophon reuse is attributed bibliographical description; exact native ancestry and substantive whole-recension distinction remain unestablished.
No literal 1488 service text or source-owned prayers transcribed.
Originalprinting 1910, deliveredphotoreprint 1970 and researchdate 2026 are separate.
Some source microfilm page edges are clipped or faint; retaining all 26 page rectangles does not restore lost text. Only the named scholarly claims were checked at page-image level.
No direct 1488 liturgical source text was transcribed or published.
